text:
[LCNT.2.1] One question decides whether a data grouping is admissible
([LCNT.1.3]):

> **Does it expose iteration, a cursor, or data-dependent traversal of
> its contents to the rule author?**

If it does, it is a collection and is rejected. If instead it offers a
fixed algebra — membership, static projection, reduction, or a closed
transform ([LCNT.3.1]) — over a well-typed grouping, it is a container.
